title: late-shift-pocket-plan-harper-2026-12-29
body:
Late-shift pocket plan — quick notes + micro tasks (use this as my walking-toward-launch checklist)

Top objectives for tonight (short bursts):
- 6 warm-touch connects: prioritize demo-ready accounts (see notes below)
- 4 follow-ups: move 2 to next-step (trial/POC/intro to SE)
- update notes in CRM and log any runway risk

Priority call list (quick paste, ordered):
1) TidalHealth — CTO (Anita K.) — 4:10pm PST — objective: confirm infra constraints for on-prem POC. Open question: can we pre-provision dedicated capacity? Leave note for solutions to prep latency benchmarks.
2) NovaRetail — AE lead (Romain) — 4:35pm PST — demo interest but cost pushback. Try bundling caching + lowerQ quant suggestion to drop unit cost.
3) OrbisAnalytics — Head of Data (Priya) — 5:00pm PST — wants tight SLOs. Ask about traffic shape: short bursts vs steady.
4) ScoutEdu — product PM (Liam) — 5:25pm PST — compliance concern (FERPA). Flag to security for quick FAQ link.
5) CraftlyMedia — growth lead (Zoe) — 5:50pm PST — use case: creative generation, okay with hosted API if privacy controls in place.
6) AgFlow — Ops (Marco) — 6:10pm PST — pilot details, pricing cadence question.

Quick call scripts / one-liners (snippets to paste):
- "We can start you on Hosted to iterate fast, then move to Dedicated when throughput stabilizes — minimal code changes."
- "If data residency is the blocker, our Private VPC option supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs."
- "For cost sensitivity, I can share a Optimize profile: batching + quantization options that shave 20–40% per token."

Follow-up templates (short):
- After intro call: "Thanks for your time — attaching the latency/cost snapshot we discussed. I’ll loop in our Solutions lead to propose a pilot."
- No response 48h: "Hi — did you have time to review the pilot outline? Quick call to align on next steps (15m) — what works?"

CRM quick notes (to paste into contact records):
- Anita K. (TidalHealth): interested in on-prem for compliance, timeline: Q1 pilot. Requires security questionnaire + infra whitepaper. Action: assign to SE for feasibility + perf tests. Ticket: JIRA-RT-1247.
- Romain (NovaRetail): price sensitivity, open to tradeoffs on latency. Action: send Optimize sketches + 2 model variant cost examples.

Micro tasks (15–30 min items):
- Drop SLO examples + quick hosting comparison into Confluence playbook (link stubbed).
- Ping #revops about possibility of offering a short-term promo for Dedicated pilot credits.
- Create 2 tailored email versions for retail and healthcare verticals.

Risk flags / red flags to watch for during calls:
- Repeated ask for support beyond AE remit (e.g., full security audits) — escalate early.
- Timeline vagueness: if customer cannot commit to a pilot window, label as nurture.
- Cost-first only signals: prefer to offer low-friction hosted trial to get usage data.

End-of-day wrap (what to update before closing):
- Log call outcomes + next steps into CRM (tags: pilot, needs-se, pricing-discussion).
- Update pipeline spreadsheet row for each account I touched (sheet: pipeline-wip).
- Set 3 follow-up reminders (2d, 7d, 14d) with specific ask per reminder.

Notes-to-self (loose):
- Remember to attach the sample latency graphs from the shared drive (path: shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/perf-snaps).
- For healthcare prospects: prep a single-page on audit logs + KMS integration. Minimal jargon, focus on sign-off docs.

Loose brainstorms (out loud):
- Quick outbound play: "pilot express" — 4-week, low-commitment trial with Dedicated credits + migration checklist. Could help convert mid-market accounts. Check with RevOps if promo feasible.
- Snippet idea for demo: show cost burn comparison (hosted vs dedicated vs quantized) for a 10k daily token workload — visual = strong persuader.

Random quick contacts to ping after calls: 
- @eliot: need perf graphs attached for TidalHealth call
- @sofia: want a 5-slide one-pager for healthcare compliance

Unresolved questions (to resolve tomorrow):
- Can sales request a short 1-week Dedicated trial with manual provisioning? (ask infra/product)
- Which models in catalog are currently marked "low-cost" vs "low-latency" — I should memorize top 3 for quick comparisons.

Short personal reminder: eat, hydrate, take a walk between calls — better outcomes after breaks.

-----
Timestamped logs (quick)
- 16:05 start prep + list reorder
- 16:40 TidalHealth call — voiced security Qs, action: SE sync
- 17:15 NovaRetail voicemail + email send (Optimize sketch)
- 17:55 OrbisAnalytics — asked for traffic profile, send form
- 18:30 ScoutEdu — compliance FAQ accepted, send follow-up
- 19:05 wrap: CRM updated, 3 reminders set

End.
